conditions: OrdinaryGet is called, returns no own property descriptor for the key, and obtains the prototype without an abrupt completion.
limitations: A present own descriptor follows a separate data or accessor branch. Other internal method implementations are outside the stated algorithm.

triggers: Controlling edition correction, applicability change, or material counterexample.

statement: ECMAScript 2024 OrdinaryGet, when it finds no own descriptor, returns undefined if the prototype is null and otherwise delegates to the prototype's [[Get]] with the same property key and receiver.
